source_document: Ayuntamiento de Huesca, Revision y Adaptacion del Plan General de Ordenacion Urbana, TEXTO REFUNDIDO, ENERO 2008 -- Plano 5, 'CLASIFICACION, CALIFICACION Y REGULACION DEL SUELO Y LA EDIFICACION EN SUELO URBANO. RED VIARIA, ALINEACIONES Y RASANTES', hoja 1 de 28, escala 1/1.000
citation_basis: every label_es string is transcribed VERBATIM from the legend panel printed on the sheet itself (out/renders/H-01_legend_*.png). The sheet's own legend is the primary source for its own symbology.

verdict_meanings.BOUND: one measurable stroke class, one planning meaning. Usable.
verdict_meanings.CLASS_BOUND_MEANING_UNKNOWN: the line is findable on the map but the sheet prints more than one meaning against it. Usable for DETECTION, never as a numeric constraint.
verdict_meanings.UNKNOWN: nothing measured, or indistinguishable from another row.

rows.planning_role: administrative extent -- not a buildability constraint
rows.why: unique measured stroke class, single legend caption

rows.planning_role: land CLASS boundary; inside it the urban ordinance applies
rows.why: unique measured stroke class, single legend caption

rows.label_es: LÍMITE DE NORMA ZONAL Y GRADOS / LÍMITE DE ÁREA DE PLANEAMIENTO INCORPORADO (API) / LÍMITE DE ÁREA DE PLANEAMIENTO ESPECÍFICO (APE) / LÍMITE DE ÁREA DE PLANEAMIENTO REMITIDO (APR)
rows.meaning_en: ONE symbol shared by FOUR different boundary meanings: zonal-norm and grade boundary, and the boundaries of the three kinds of planning area
rows.planning_role: boundary of SOMETHING -- which of the four is not recoverable from the line itself
rows.why: the sheet prints 4 distinct planning meanings against this ONE swatch, so a line of this class cannot be attributed to a single meaning from the drawing alone

rows.meaning_en: rasante -- the official finished ground level, in metres
rows.planning_role: the DATUM from which height is measured. Printed as a symbol plus a number (the legend's example reads 4.80)
rows.why: unique measured stroke class, single legend caption

rows.meaning_en: official alignment -- the line the façade must sit on
rows.planning_role: the FRONT of the buildable envelope
rows.why: unique measured stroke class, single legend caption

rows.label_es: CAMBIO DE ALTURA Y USO / FONDO EDIFICABLE
rows.meaning_en: EITHER a change-of-height-and-use line OR the buildable depth line -- the sheet prints both captions against ONE swatch
rows.planning_role: would be the BACK of the buildable envelope IF the line is a fondo edificable -- but the same symbol also denotes a height/use change, which is NOT a depth limit
rows.why: the sheet prints 2 distinct planning meanings against this ONE swatch, so a line of this class cannot be attributed to a single meaning from the drawing alone

rows.planning_role: ground-floor void obligation under the built volume
rows.why: unique measured stroke class, single legend caption
